lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Can Canada afford Carney’s budget?, CityNews Vancouver reports.
Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang over Chinese spy concerns, CBS News reports.
Rep. Thomas Massie launches bid to impeach U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, The Associated Press reports.
A Calgary man is facing charges after allegedly stealing a large amount of cash and merchandise from a store where he worked, CTV News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
